x: We were all very deeply shocked to hear of the death of C. Young, of Queen's Park Harriers, who was knocked down by a motor-car and died on his way to hospital.
Quite the tit-bit of the race was the tussle between C. Young, Essex Beagles, and R. Linstead of Belgrave, who finished together in 13th and 14th positions.
Our winning margin on this occasion was 13 seconds only from Birchfield - a most exciting race, marred only by the death of C. Young of Queens Park Harriers who was killed on the road.

He won by 163 points from C.Young of Worthing scoring 6577 points. Ronnie McCrossen and David Didino, both Youths, with the latter only in his first year in the age group at that, showed great courage in tackling their first decathlon competition - the S.C.A.A.A.
